dedupe_keys.name: madeira ptprosumer household pv production and net load

description: The PTProsumer team publishes photovoltaic production and net-load measurements for twenty-four residential and small-commercial prosumers on Madeira Island, Portugal. The public OSF description states one-second electricity measurements over individual periods ranging from three months to five years, with one-minute solar-irradiation estimates from CAMS. The OSF repository provides public access to the measurement files. Coverage is twenty-four prosumers on Madeira Island. Licence: CC-BY-4.0, read from the DataCite record of its DOI on 2026-09-28; obtaining it is free of charge. The observations can calibrate household solar self-consumption and net-load variability in distribution-grid simulations using contexts such as model-pypsa-eur. A caveat is that net load combines production and consumption, and the record says the components are provided separately; model users should preserve that distinction. The twenty-four participants are not a representative island-wide demand census. The own node description was read without downloading files or verifying sensor gaps and timestamps.
